name: @sparx/query
description: sparx client data layer — the blessed TanStack Query setup. Server-first stays the default (RSC reads + server-action writes); this package is the standard for client-interactive server state only (polling, debounced search, refetch-on-focus, optimistic mutations). Ships an isomorphic QueryClient factory, a client <QueryProvider>, a server-only SSR-prefetch helper, and the shared query-key factory. See docs/95-client-data-fetching.md.
